label: context.reference
text:
Installation does not connect a run. To connect lifecycle handling through authorized file edits:
1. Author an immutable lifecycle.connection payload. Bind its exact artifact id with read access at each connected checkpoint of the emitter, handler owner and Agent destination runs.
2. Set interface_state.<provider>.lifecycle_connection to the same connection id, exact system_lifecycle_events interface and exact content-addressed ArtifactRef.
3. Grant the required destination interfaces/tools and lifecycle.decision.allowed outcome. Author run bindings as {interface,config:{artifact_policy:{mode,names,namespaces}}}.
4. Route the provider's lifecycle.event output to system_lifecycle_events. For sync events, derive the lifecycle.decision return checkpoint on that interface with verifier lifecycle_decision and mark lifecycle.decision.allowed. Do not use an unverified decision input checkpoint.
5. Deliver the exact event to each handler owner. Command uses a granted Tool route; MCP an exact World-interface route; Prompt an exact provider route; Agent an exact system_worker_* route. Route handler results explicitly from the executing provider to system_lifecycle_events.
6. For Agent, connect a destination run whose worker input passes lifecycle.handler.task to its provider, and whose provider result returns lifecycle.decision or lifecycle.handler.output to system_lifecycle_events.
7. Record the connection payload and every edited run/policy record as content-addressed lifecycle.connection.authoring evidence.

Sources, defaults, wildcards and ambient hooks cannot substitute for these bindings and grants.
